case: PostgreSQL boolean[] file exports and SQL replay
contract: The array contains true, false and SQL NULL values; PostgreSQL array text, array_to_json and array_send provide native oracles, and typed rebinding matches the native values and bytes.
JSON and CSV decode to the exact array text; XML, HTML, Markdown and XLSX assert text encodings with their escaping rules.
SQL-file replay retains the boolean[] type, JSON semantics and exact array_send bytes.

focused_docker_test.command: rtk proxy cargo test --locked -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration array_contract::value_contract_boolean_array_file_exports_preserve_values_for_calc_reimport -- --ignored --exact --nocapture --test-threads=1

remaining: Other PostgreSQL array families, engine/type/consumer/configuration combinations and installed application re-imports remain open in B3.
